What we need from you: 
- Confirm whether Novum prefers ACH or wire for this invoice.
- If ACH, confirm bank name + ACH routing and account last 4 digits; if wire, confirm you'll provide the payment reference so we can match.
- If you expect the card processor to decline, please confirm you can do an expedited wire.

Attachments: Invoice_4592.pdf (PDF) and Redwood_W9.pdf (PDF) — W9 included per your earlier request.

If you can reply with a one-line confirmation by Sunday 5:00 PM PT we will:
- Place the invoice into the Sunday sweep batch (treasury runs the capture at 18:00 PT)
- Standby the dedicated collection queue and route to wire fallback if ACH fails

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this one.

Can you confirm the exact legal remit name and Redwood's tax ID (you included the W9, but we need to confirm the exact remit string we should use)? If you can send the wire summary as a separate attachment it will help our team triage faster.

FYI: If ACH fails and we opt for a wire, our procurement desk requires a one-minute confirmation call with the approver (we can do that by phone).
